title: WayselectProvenanceDriftReport
description: Versioned schema (v1) for the bin/check-provenance-drift --out JSON report consumed by the refresh scheduler. Fail-closed: additionalProperties is false at every object level. The report is written on every run that gets past argument parsing — green (ok true) and red (ok false with per-check fail entries) alike — so scheduler consumers can rely on the shape regardless of exit code.

ok.description: True only when D1, D2 and D3 all pass. Mirrors the process exit code (0/1).

issue.description: Owning probe issue; pinned so consumers can detect a probe-generation change.

ranAt.description: Wall-clock time the report was built (RFC 3339).

catalog.description: Resolved catalog path the probe read (as passed via --catalog or the default).

evidence.description: Resolved evidence path the probe read (as passed via --evidence or the default).

snapshotTimestamp.description: Recorded catalog snapshot timestamp, or null when the body was unreadable.

recordedHash.description: Snapshot hash recorded in the fixture provenance (D1 expectation). String when present, null when unreadable. Deliberately pattern-open: on red runs this can carry the mismatching value that D1 rejected.

recomputedHash.description: Canonical SHA-256 recomputed over the live catalog body, or null when the body could not be hashed. Deliberately pattern-open for the same reason as recordedHash.

evidenceHash.description: Provenance hash pinned by the last harness run (D2 expectation), or null when the evidence file carries no string hash. Deliberately pattern-open: malformed pins are a D2 FAIL, still reported.

evidenceVerdict.description: Passthrough of the raw evidence verdict (expected "PASS"). Any JSON value is accepted — the verdict domain is open by design (anything but PASS is a D2 FAIL) — null when unreadable.

now.description: Reference clock for the D3 freshness window (as passed via --now or wall-clock).

freshness.description: D3 freshness probe result. Null only when D3 could not run (e.g. unreadable timestamp input).

ageMs.description: now minus snapshotTimestamp in ms; negative means a future-dated snapshot (D3 FAIL).

checks.description: Per-check table, always exactly the D1/D2/D3 entries in order.

detail.description: Human-readable one-liner; machine consumers must key on name/status, not this text.
